description:
## Problem
HTTP clients created in `HtmlExtractor#extract_all` and `ManifestExtractor#extract_favicons_from_manifest` are never closed. Under high concurrency and retry scenarios, this exhausts file descriptors.

## Files
- `src/vug/html_extractor.cr` (lines 45-65)
- `src/vug/manifest_extractor.cr` (lines 68-95)

## Fix
Wrap client usage in `begin...ensure` blocks and call `client.close` or `@http_client_factory.release_client` in the `ensure` clause.

## Acceptance
- Both extractors close HTTP clients in all code paths (success, error, retry)
- Existing tests still pass
- New test verifying client cleanup on exception
title: Fix HTTP client resource leaks in HtmlExtractor and ManifestExtractor
